_comment: Approximate fare and speed MODEL for modes without a usable fare API. These are NOT quotes. Each entry carries a 'basis' shown to users and a 'verify' note. Update with sourced values before relying on them.

bus.basis: Project fare rule: ₹10 up to 1 km, then ₹8 for each further (started) km
bus.verify: Interim rule set by the product owner; replace with the Kerala MVD / KSRTC fare table when available

ferry.basis: Typical Kochi public boat/Ro-Ro passenger fare range, approximate
ferry.verify: Check SWTD / KSINC fare for the specific jetty pair

bike_taxi.basis: Typical app bike-taxi pricing in Kochi, approximate; surge not included

auto_rickshaw.basis: Kerala auto-rickshaw meter tariff (minimum + per-km), approximate
auto_rickshaw.verify: Check current Kerala auto tariff notification

taxi.basis: Typical app cab (hatchback) pricing in Kochi, approximate; surge not included

transitDefaults.basis: Bus feed headways are a uniform 60-minute placeholder; an assumed 20-minute headway (10-minute expected wait) is used instead.

group.basis: Groups: public transport is charged per person; road rides need enough vehicles (bike taxi 1 passenger, auto 3, hatchback taxi 4). Bike taxis are not offered for groups of 3 or more.
group.verify: Seat counts are typical; larger cabs (SUV, 6-7 seats) are not modelled

ranking.scenicBasis: Day planner 'scenic' preference: each ferry minute counts 1.5 minutes cheaper and each walking minute 0.3 minutes cheaper than the balanced score.
